title: metastelma ovalifolium
intro: Metastelma ovalifolium, commonly known as oval-leaved metastelma, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is a perennial herb with numerous health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of Metastelma ovalifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
